I reviewed each helper and judged whether it would help accomplish the specific task: "Find the link to the 'Previous Post' and click it." The key requirements for that task are: operate on the current post page (not navigate away), locate a link whose visible text or accessible name is "Previous Post" (or similar) and click it. Most listed helpers begin by navigating to '/' and/or are bulk-scraping utilities that do not provide a simple, safe click-on-current-page behavior — using them would either be overkill or would change the page state in ways that are undesirable for the simple click task. Explicit per-function decisions follow:

- monitor_keyword_and_notify: Not useful — navigates to '/' and scans homepage articles; no facility to click a "Previous Post" link on the current post page.
- search_keyword_group_by_category: Not useful — homepage/category discovery helper that begins with page.goto('/'); not appropriate for in-page "Previous Post" click.
- fetch_posts_by_category_and_date_range: Not useful — navigates to '/' then a category page and extracts posts; does not click in-page post navigation links and would disturb current page state.
- compile_recent_posts_digest: Not useful — navigates to '/' and compiles posts into Markdown; not intended to locate/click a "Previous Post" link on a post page.
- extract_post_summaries: Not useful — navigates to '/' and extracts/writes CSV of summaries; not relevant to clicking an in-page navigation link.
- export_posts_by_category_date_range: Not useful — high-level export that navigates to '/' and delegates discovery; not for clicking previous post link.
- export_category_posts_to_csv: Not useful — navigates to '/' and delegates per-category extraction; not for in-page navigation click.
- create_weekly_newsletter_draft: Not useful — navigates to '/' and delegates digest creation; not relevant.
- export_visible_posts_to_csv: Not useful — wrapper around extract_post_summaries that navigates to '/'; not useful for clicking a previous-post link.
- export_recent_posts_to_markdown: Not useful — navigates to '/' and delegates to compile_recent_posts_digest; not helpful for the task.
- create_curated_collection_by_search: Not useful — navigates to '/' and drives the search widget and then scrapes results; not for in-page "Previous Post" click.
- detect_and_report_duplicate_posts: Not useful — navigates to '/' and computes similarity across visible posts; not relevant to finding/clicking previous post link.
- create_weekly_newsletter: Not useful — navigates to '/' and delegates to compile_recent_posts_digest; not helpful.
- create_category_weekly_newsletter: Not useful — although it can visit individual post URLs to extract excerpts, it still begins by navigating to '/' and is intended to assemble newsletters. It does not provide a safe, minimal operation to locate and click the "Previous Post" link on the current page; using it would be overkill and would likely change page state.
- create_curated_collection_and_newsletter: Not useful — delegates to search and newsletter helpers and navigates to '/'; not suitable.

Summary: None of the provided helpers are a good fit. They either start by navigating to the site root (page.goto('/')) or perform large scraping workflows; none offer a direct, minimal operation that simply finds and clicks a "Previous Post" link on the current page. For this task it is better to use simple page.locator/get_by_role/get_by_text with a click (for example: await page.get_by_role('link', name=re.compile('Previous', re.I)).click() or await page.locator("a:has-text('Previous Post')").click()).
